X Follow Checker

Check who doesn't follow you back on X.com

⚠️ Web version requires manual token input.
For easier use, install the Chrome Extension.
How to get your token?
  1. Log in to x.com
  2. Open Developer Tools (F12)
  3. Go to Application → Cookies → x.com
  4. Find "ct0" and copy its value
  5. Paste it above
